name: 78640 · Kyle, TX
findings: ZIP 78640 (Kyle) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78640 (Kyle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
